name: fence_post
note: End / cap post. Same 96 px shared post, west-south position as the EW and west-NS pieces. Place in the next tile to close an EW or NS run. The left face at EW rail height has a 1 px outline break so incoming EW rails meet wood, not a hard black seam.
construction: Composited at 1:1 from the shared post and rail set (pilot fence_straight). No new generation.
